final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) as avg_rebtotal, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_diff FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_diff) as overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.orderslink, s1.avg_rebtotal, s1.avg_diff, s1.avg_diff - s2.overall_avg as diff_from_avg FROM step1 s1 CROSS JOIN step2 s2 WHERE s1.avg_diff > s2.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(avg_rebtotal), AVG(avg_diff), AVG(diff_from_avg) FROM step3
